parameters.query:
WITH payload AS (SELECT '{{$json.payload_sql}}'::jsonb AS body), approval AS (
  INSERT INTO content_approvals (job_id, approval_stage, decision, reviewer_id, reviewer_type, reviewer_notes)
  SELECT NULLIF(body->>'job_id','')::uuid, body->>'approval_stage', body->>'decision', COALESCE(NULLIF(body->>'reviewer_id',''),'human:operator'), 'human', COALESCE(body->>'notes','') FROM payload
  RETURNING job_id, approval_stage, decision
), job_update AS (
  UPDATE content_jobs SET status=CASE
    WHEN (SELECT approval_stage FROM approval)='analysis' AND (SELECT decision FROM approval)='approved' THEN 'analysis_complete'::job_status
    WHEN (SELECT approval_stage FROM approval)='plan' AND (SELECT decision FROM approval)='approved' THEN 'generating_outputs'::job_status
    WHEN (SELECT approval_stage FROM approval)='final_delivery' AND (SELECT decision FROM approval)='approved' THEN 'waiting_for_human_review'::job_status
    WHEN (SELECT decision FROM approval)='revision_requested' THEN 'paused'::job_status
    WHEN (SELECT decision FROM approval)='rejected' THEN 'cancelled'::job_status
    ELSE status END, updated_at=now()
  WHERE id=(SELECT job_id FROM approval) RETURNING id, status
), event_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO content_events (job_id,event_type,message,metadata)
  SELECT job_id,'approval_recorded','Human approval decision recorded',jsonb_build_object('approval_stage',approval_stage,'decision',decision,'human_only',true) FROM approval
)
SELECT job_id::text, approval_stage, decision, (SELECT status::text FROM job_update) AS status FROM approval;
